name: Outlook (Rui)
description: Search, read, send, draft and organize Outlook and Microsoft 365 email. Accesses Microsoft Graph through Cindy-managed OAuth and token injection; connect an account in the plugin details page before first use.
whenToUse: Use to connect Outlook, Hotmail, Live or Microsoft 365 work mailboxes and search, read, send, draft or organize mail.

tools.name: outlook_accounts
tools.description: List connected accounts, the default account and application setup status. Multiple accounts can stay signed in at once. Optionally pass profile_account to read that account's mail and user_principal_name through a read-only Graph query. A sign-in name is not necessarily the receiving address; do not guess when mail is empty. Reads no mail and returns no tokens.

profile_account.description: Optional: an account ID returned by this tool. Only when given, reads that account's Graph mail (may be empty) and user_principal_name. Never treat the sign-in name as the receiving address.

tools.name: outlook_mail
tools.description: Search, read, send, save drafts, list folders, mark read/unread and move messages. Send, draft and organize actions must come from explicit user intent; before sending, verify the sender account, recipients and content. A successful send only means Microsoft accepted the request, not that it was delivered; if the result is unknown, check the mailbox first and do not retry directly. read does not mark messages read; page tokens are bound to the account and action. Microsoft cloud mailboxes only; other providers and on-premises Exchange are not supported.

account.description: Account ID returned by outlook_accounts. Verify the sender account before sending; if omitted, the default account is used.

cloud.description: Service region; only global (Outlook / Microsoft 365) is supported. Optional; the region is detected from account when given.

query.description: search: Microsoft KQL full-text search, e.g. from:person@example.test. Cannot be combined with from/subject/unread/since/before; Microsoft full-text search returns at most 1000 messages.

subject.description: search: subject contains this text; send/draft: subject, empty string allowed.

unread.description: search: true for unread, false for read, omit for no filter.

since.description: search: inclusive start time; ISO dates are UTC, times must include a time zone.

before.description: search: exclusive end time; ISO dates are UTC, times must include a time zone.

folder.description: search: limit to this folder; list_folders: list its child folders. If omitted, all mail / the root folders respectively. Use an ID from a query or a Microsoft well-known name such as inbox, sentitems or drafts.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page, passed back unchanged. Use the same action, account and cloud; when paging, do not also pass filters or max_results.

message_id.description: read/mark_read/mark_unread/move: the original message ID. After a move, use the returned new ID.

target_folder.description: move: target folder ID or Microsoft well-known name. For custom folders, find the ID with list_folders first.

body_text.description: send/draft: plain-text body, empty string allowed. Total request size must not exceed 250 KB.

to.description: send/draft: to email addresses as an array or comma/semicolon-separated text, without display names. At most 100 recipients in total.

cc.description: send/draft: cc email addresses as an array or comma/semicolon-separated text, without display names. At most 100 recipients in total.

bcc.description: send/draft: bcc email addresses as an array or comma/semicolon-separated text, without display names. At most 100 recipients in total.

author: Rui Valim

secrets.label: Microsoft account (global)
secrets.hint: Connect an account in the plugin details page; whether a work account needs administrator approval depends on tenant policy.
